title: Mixpanel MCP Server Now Supports EU and IN Projects! 🌍✨
summary: It's officially here!! Mixpanel MCP Server now supports EU and IN projects 🌎 🔥 | @everyone We've heard all your feedback, and we're excited to launch MCP support for our customers using our EU and India data centers (https://docs.mixpanel.com/changelogs/2025-11-20-mcp-in-eu). Organization admins can enable this feature for their entire organization in Settings > Org > Overview. From there, your teams can talk to their Mixpanel data in natural language through AI tools, like Claude Pro and Free, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor. Get started today with the help of our support docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp). 🗣️ And as always, we want to hear from you! Share your feedback with the team directly via the form on the docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#overview).
